dependencies: Real Spring, pinned PostgreSQL, production Next.js, Caddy and two independent synthetic remote Git repositories; no mocked UI or application responses.
captureMethod: Nine original browser frames sampled in order from one fresh owner/member flow. GIF uses 1.8 seconds per frame for reading, not measured transition timing. Login, fixture setup and the grant-selection interaction are omitted from the recording. The final frame reads back the saved public-only grant.
setup: Real registration and workspace-invitation HTTP operations against the isolated fixture.
flow: Owner views default empty invitation grants and public-reading member
Member reads public source and a decoded 320x180 Git image with editing disabled
Private path is refused while the prior public preview remains visible
Public-only publisher opens the picker showing decoded public Git images
Member saves an appended public paragraph and a relative image link without private reading or writing
Private target control is disabled; member renames within public scope
Editor confirms the move and refreshes the preserved text and image preview
The inserted image still renders after the move
Owner reads back the saved publication-only member grant
limitations: Loopback HTTP and synthetic content. Does not prove external OAuth/MCP client interoperability, provider provisioning, production HTTPS, public-only machine authoring or transition timing.
